ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white (>80% of surface) with low-intensity black perimeter and focal spots creating a high macro-level contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity (black) contiguous banding along the trailing edge and distal tips; multiple discrete circular low-intensity clusters (rosettes) distributed non-uniformly across the high-intensity (white) medial surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 70-80 degrees relative to the medial lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged continuous boundary; multiple high-frequency peaks and valleys with a pixel-amplitude variation of approximately 3-8 pixels along the entire trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curvature extending from the medial notch vertex to the distal lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular pixel clusters (dark-on-light) distributed across both lobes; approximately 8-10 distinct clusters on the left lobe and 5-7 on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal dark linear disruption on the upper right lobe; multiple smaller vertical linear marks on the lower medial left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced jagged erosion/fragmentation of both distal tips; concentrated circular pitting and scarring consistent with localized surface trauma across the central fluke body.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-intensity focal point within the dark pigmentation at the base of the median notch.
